Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc.
David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc.
Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc

profile_text.body:
Runway is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, NY, with a recently announced European headquarters in London. The company describes itself as building foundational "Real-World Intelligence" capable of understanding, simulating, and acting in the world, with products and services built on top of that foundation. Its core technology is GWM-1, described on its site as a state-of-the-art General World Model intended for interaction with the real world and universal simulation. The company has also announced a planned $100M investment in the UK AI ecosystem alongside the London expansion.

Runway's primary tracked product is its video generation platform, which sits within the video generation and editing category. Additional offerings described on its site include the Runway Dev platform, which incorporates a tool called Runway Media Router, characterized as the first preference-optimized router for generative media. The company also references capabilities spanning policy inference, evaluation, and synthetic data generation, all powered by GWM-1.

On the legal side, Runway carries notable litigation exposure. The held facts record four cases naming Runway AI, Inc. as a defendant, including two actions brought by David Vance Gardner filed in the Southern District of New York and the Central District of California respectively, as well as cases brought by Businessing LLC and Ace Cam, Inc., both in the Southern District of New York. Runway is also named as a co-defendant in Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd., filed in the Northern District of California. The site's law exposure data associates the company with 220 matters coded to New York.
